newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean brewery CCU granted $75 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Chilean brewery CCU granted $75 mln loan.

text.p: Chilean beer-maker Compania Cervecerias Unidas SA said it has received a $75 million syndicated loan to prepay a short-term debt and boost its investments in Argentina.
The loan was granted to CCU's unit in the Cayman Islands with Citibank acting as agent for the deal, said CCU in a statement to the Securities Superintendency.
Around $24 million from the loan will be used to fund a capital increase in the company's division CCU Argentina SA, it said.
CCU, Chile's largest brewery, owns two plants in Argentina and last year signed a deal with Anheuser Busch to brew Budweiser in Argentina.
